name: Lavenders (LAVNDR120)
overview: Lavenders reveals consumer behaviour: what people actually order, when, and from which businesses, drawn from the real orders of 120 businesses and brands, turned into a live index (LAVNDR120) and reports for businesses and brands. Lavenders is a digital market system that brings together 120 businesses and brands in one market; each business runs its own order-management app (OMS), and their real orders feed one live consumer index called LAVNDR120. Lavenders is the brand; LAVNDR120 is the index. Unrelated to lavender plants or oil.
disclaimers: No buying, selling or trading of shares on the platform.
Informational only: not investment advice and no promise of profit or returns.
Terms and agreements are drafts pending legal review.
Prices are as of 1 November 2026; the home page is the source of truth.

faq.a: Lavenders reveals consumer behaviour: what people actually order, when, and from which businesses, drawn from the real orders of 120 businesses and brands, turned into a live index (LAVNDR120) and reports for businesses and brands. It is a digital market system that brings together 120 businesses and brands in one market. Each business runs its own order-management app (OMS).

faq.q: What consumer behaviour does Lavenders reveal?
faq.a: Lavenders reads the real orders of the 120 businesses and brands in a market: which products and services are requested most, how order activity moves over time, and how the market behaves as a whole. This is shown as a live consumer index (LAVNDR120), read-only market data (Lava) and a forecasting report on market behaviour (Vindex). It is descriptive information only, with no promise of profit or returns.

faq.q: What is the difference between Lavenders and LAVNDR120?
faq.a: Lavenders is the name of the system and the brand. LAVNDR120 is the name of its consumer index.
It is the number of businesses and brands in each market.
No. There is no buying, selling or trading of shares inside the platform. The index measures the real order activity of the businesses.

faq.q: Is this investment advice or a promise of returns?
faq.a: No. The information is descriptive only. There is no promise of profit or returns, and any participation is subject to the platform's terms and agreements.

faq.q: Is Lavenders related to lavender plants?
faq.a: No. The name is a brand for a digital market system and has nothing to do with lavender plants or oil.
Yes. It is downloaded directly from the official site, lavndrs120.github.io. It is not currently on Google Play.

faq.q: What do visitors who have not subscribed see?
faq.a: Only the real index card. Other screens show demo data for visitors and real data for subscribers.

faq.a: See the OMS package and the Economic Movement path on the packages page.
